title: Papyrus ships a neutral public theme and two example themes
description:
Requested by Humorus (https://github.com/AnthusAI/Humorus), the satire publications that run a second, very different newsroom on Papyrus. Humorus issue: HUM-1be843.

Factor the useful parts of the Machines on Machines design (cards, layout preset, tokens at final sizes) into core as the default theme. A site with only a name looks finished; a brand pack of tokens restyles it; a brand pack cannot carry code. Pulls forward PPY-31efef, PPY-3aa10f, PPY-e572de, PPY-0f4e10 and PPY-2a44b2. Machines on Machines must look the same afterwards.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Plan (design doc docs/plans/shared-publication-front-end.md, 2026-11-15). Slices in order: 1 tokens at final sizes + core card set, scaler retired (PPY-2a44b2, part of PPY-31efef); 2 publication layout preset + language base (switcher, banner, strings) (PPY-31efef); 3 brand pack v2 applied by the projection (PPY-88a883, PPY-e572de rendering half); 4 TheHallucinator.ai on the base with a satire brand pack and site.notice (Humorus); 5 neutral default + starter template (PPY-3aa10f); 6 papyrus site init (PPY-f30ad5, later). Every slice that changes how MoM renders ships behind a before/after visual diff at 375 and 1440 px, light and dark, es-419 and zh-Hans included, and Ryan's preview approval. Slices 1 and 2 start only after the in-flight listing, index-page and localize branches merge.
